editorial:
Imagine being a talented engineer but losing everything because of a bad economy. That is exactly where you find Reino. He is down on his luck after getting laid off from a shipyard, and to make things worse, he is not rich enough for a factory owner to accept him as a son-in-law. On top of that, he has lost the love of his life, Maire. It sounds like a total nightmare, but the movie turns into a sweet and funny story when Reino meets Hillin-Jussi. Jussi is a jobless rogue with a wild spirit, and their unlikely friendship brings a lot of warmth and laughter to a tough time in history.

You will really enjoy the chemistry between the two leads and the way the film balances sadness with lighthearted jokes. The pacing feels breezy, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you are used to modern action. If you love old-school charm and stories about finding hope in hard times, you should definitely give this a try. Since it is a classic, you might want to find a high-quality restoration to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or perhaps rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. If you are a big collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: In the end, Reino stops worrying about what the factory owner thinks and finds true contentment through his bond with Jussi. He realizes that friendship and happiness are more important than social status or a fancy job. The story wraps up with Reino finding a new sense of purpose and joy, showing that even when you lose everything, you can still find a lucky break in the most unexpected people.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic romantic comedies and stories about unlikely friendships.
